comment: pickup.c in_or_out_menu() 3468-3476 returns (n == 0 && more_containers) ? 'n' : 'q'. A debug-mode dwarvish Archeologist wishes for two sacks, drops both, #loots and selects both containers; at the first sack's 'Do what with the sack?' menu, ESC (n == -1) answers 'q', so use_container() sets abort_looting (pickup.c 3126-3127) and the second sack is never offered.
